official_resolution.resolved_title: Iterative Refinement Diffusion for Super-Resolved Data Assimilation of Multiscale Physical Systems

root_cause.why: The canonical Primary intake already verifies the candidate title against the official arXiv page and rejects title similarity below 0.72. The bad title-ref pair was not present in Git history or the public authoritative Primary/Fresh/System states, so the incorrect association occurred before canonical intake, during an external paper-to-asset-triage handoff that had no standalone bibliographic identity receipt.

remediation.identity_gate: A title-ref pair must resolve through official arXiv metadata and meet the title-similarity threshold before any read-only first-party asset audit is authorized.
remediation.mismatch_behavior: Quarantine the pair, preserve the official identity of the supplied ref, run a title-only official recovery search, and never silently retarget to a semantically similar paper.
remediation.recovery_behavior: A unique title-search candidate is only a rebind candidate; asset audit remains blocked until the recovered ref is re-verified as a matching title-ref pair.
remediation.asset_handoff_gate: The official asset audit performs zero network asset probes until the identity receipt is VERIFIED_BIBLIOGRAPHIC_IDENTITY; only primary-page-declared GitHub, Hugging Face, or project endpoints can be forwarded for read-only content review.
remediation.experiment_behavior: Bibliographic verification never grants Method, Experiment, P0, GPU, or scientific authority.

current_disposition.next_action: Obtain a primary identifier for the intended GTP paper. Re-run the bibliographic identity gate; only a VERIFIED_BIBLIOGRAPHIC_IDENTITY receipt may hand off directly to official GitHub/Hugging Face/project/Lean-verifier asset audit. Do not redo prior deduplication.
